headline: As of 05:00: every team filed its Sunday status on time; a founder's hands-on test of the new CRM Add screens is still next.
items: All executive teams and the Chief of Staff filed their Sunday status, with no missed cutoffs.
The internal CRM update's technical run stays accepted; a founder's own Add test is the last step before product acceptance.
Thursday status cutoffs move to the morning starting this week.
Teams are trimming scheduled bot runs to cut usage.
The company decision log and internal CRM guide were updated.
